_description: ISCA'27 scale model s = 1/8 with the network scaled too (user 10-26 eve): mi200_eighth.json plus -scale-network, which divides the wafer network and wafer-shared translation sizes by 8 in the simulator (link bandwidth, switch buffer flits, endpoint channels/buffers when set, RDMA pipeline width and max outstanding, T18 windows and tables, -pm-pull-window, IOMMU TLB sets, MMU walks in flight). The flags on the command line keep their full-scale values (e.g. -bandwidth=24 -rdma-max-outstanding=128); latencies, topology, clock, page size and the migration software / shootdown latencies are not scaled. Use as the last config, e.g. -config m3p_r3real.json,mi200_eighth_net.json.
